customer_message.body:
Good afternoon

Given the unusual circumstance: Two weeks after I reported the damp wall in writing, I received a termination for own use; It had never been mentioned before; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights”, my first account covers: the landlord motive remains unresolved; for the request “preserve the deadline and review the motive and chronology”: I currently have only part of the records; on “potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights”, I want clarity before acting; also unresolved: the own use evidence; that is the basis of my request.

My question is: preserve the deadline and review the motive and chronology; in particular, I need clarity about the own use evidence and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

My first note about it is dated 19 June 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; I need a clear reply about the landlord motive; Only then will I know what to do.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Request for a detailed review: potentially abusive termination after asserting tenancy rights
